![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

This is another instance of a potential Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability. The song title from YouTube is rendered directly into the HTML. A malicious song title could execute scripts in the user's browser.

Please sanitize this value before rendering, for example by using a helper function as suggested in the other comment.

```suggestion
                            ${sanitizeHTML(queue.nowPlaying.title)}
```

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg) Similar to other parts of the UI, rendering log messages directly with `innerHTML` creates an XSS vulnerability. If a log message contains user-provided data with HTML, it could be executed. Please sanitize the log content before rendering. You can use the same `sanitizeHTML` helper function mentioned in the other comments. ```suggestion return `
${sanitizeHTML(log)}
`; ```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

For better performance and reliability, consider bundling the frontend assets (Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons) instead of loading them from a CDN. This makes the dashboard independent of external services and can improve load times, especially if the server is on a local network. Tools like Vite or Parcel could help with this.
